# rixl_client_credential (Resource)

Manages OAuth 2.0 client credentials (client ID and client secret) for machine-to-machine authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_client_credential" "backend_service" {
  org_id = var.rixl_org_id
  name   = "backend-transcoder-service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `alg` (String)
- `org_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String)
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive)
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. "2024-12-25T12:00:00Z".
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `kid` (String)
- `last_used_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. "2024-12-25T12:00:00Z".
- `status` (String)
